raw:
I'm submitting 100 experiments in ten groups of ten, as one batch with no adaptive follow-up. Each group fixes one edit and runs it on parents that vary one other edge at a time. That way the change in effect can be attributed to a single parent edge. Within each group, the parents vary the op the edit replaces, the neighbouring edges that feed or follow the edited edge (e.g. edge 3 and edge 4 for an edit on edge 0), and the all-same-op backgrounds (all conv1x1, all conv3x3, all pool, all skip).

I haven't run any of these, so there are no results or hypotheses yet.
